entity.name: FOSS CEAL
entity.description: A student-led Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) community at College of Engineering Attingal dedicated to promoting open-source technologies, collaborative software development, and community-driven learning through events, workshops, and contribution programs.

projects.name: Commit Overflow
projects.description: Commit Overflow is a month-long, beginner-friendly Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) contribution program organized by the FOSS CEAL, in collaboration with LBSITW FOSS CLUB. The program equips students with the skills required to make meaningful contributions to real-world open-source projects through structured mentorship, hands-on learning, and guided collaboration.

channels.description: UPI payment page for supporting Commit Overflow.

plans.name: Contributor Prize Money
plans.description: This will provide prize money to recognize and reward contributors who make meaningful contributions during Commit Overflow.

plans.name: Developer & Maintenance Support
plans.description: This will support the development, maintenance, bug fixes and improvements required to operate the Commit Overflow platform during the initiative, including maintaining the platform, addressing issues identified during the program, and improving the contributor experience.

plans.name: Hosting & Infrastructure
plans.description: This will support the electricity and internet connectivity required to operate the self-hosted infrastructure, along with database, storage, deployment, monitoring, and other infrastructure costs required to keep the Commit Overflow platform available throughout the initiative.

plans.name: Custom Contribution
plans.description: Support Commit Overflow with any custom amount of your choice.
